notes: The first supplied copula goes to the interrogative predicate τίς under rule 63, the subject ἐλπίς being a lexical noun; the second goes to ἔμπροσθεν under rule 53, the predicate there being a prepositional phrase. Neither is read off English word order, and the second is discontinuous under rule 15.
s010 ἤ is unrepresented, the ASV starting a fresh question with no disjunctive word. A reference comparison will report it as a disagreement, and that report is not a correction.
οὐχί carries content of its own and is aligned to not in the ordinary way under rule 64; the question is marked by inversion.
